<!--
Please use this template only for defects in code or documentation that

-->

## Where

- Affected file(s) or directory (e.g. `labs/foo/scripts/reproduce.sh`):
- Commit hash you observed the issue on (`git rev-parse HEAD`):

## What went wrong

A short, specific description of the observed behavior. Screenshots and
logs are welcome but not required.

## Expected behavior

What you expected instead, and why (link to a README section or a spec if
useful).

## Minimal reproduction

```text
# Exact commands, inputs, and any relevant environment variables.
# One command per line. Please include the output.
```

## Environment

- OS and version:
- Language / runtime version (e.g. `python --version`, `node --version`):
- Anything unusual about the environment (WSL, container, non-x86 CPU, etc.):

## Additional context

Anything else that might help — related issues, a hypothesis about the
cause, links to prior art.
